read.thesis: Q3 beat on comps (+4%) and adjusted margin, but FY27 adjusted EPS guide is $5.17–5.20 versus prior $5.15–5.20 and Q4 adjusted EPS $1.42–1.45 is raised only on tariff accrual and fuel costs; Q4 comp cut to 2–3%.

triggers.label: Inventory per store flat y/y
triggers.quote: Consolidated inventories on a per-store basis as of October 31, 2026, including distribution centers, but excluding inventory in transit and the Company’s e-commerce sites, were flat on both a reported and constant currency basis, versus last year.

triggers.label: Q4 comp cut to 2% to 3%
triggers.quote: For the fourth quarter of Fiscal 2027, the Company is planning consolidated comparable sales to be up 2% to 3%.

triggers.label: Adjusted gross margin down 0.5pt on freight and fuel
triggers.quote: Excluding a 0.8 percentage point net benefit from tariff refunds, adjusted gross profit margin was 32.1%, down 0.5 percentage points versus the prior year. This was driven by higher freight and fuel costs.

guidance.quote: For the full year Fiscal 2027, the Company now expects consolidated comparable sales to be up 4%.
the Company continues to expect its full-year adjusted pretax profit margin to be in the range of 12.0% to 12.1%.
the Company expects its full year outlook for adjusted diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $5.17 to $5.20.
the Company expects adjusted diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $1.42 to $1.45.
the Company is planning consolidated comparable sales to be up 2% to 3%.
The Company now expects to repurchase approximately $3.0 billion of TJX stock during Fiscal 2027.
